subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should ClawHub establish this consolidated plugin verification endpoint as a public trust contract before the linked vetted-community RFC settles the permanent review and publisher semantics?
rationale: The endpoint defines how clients interpret security, provenance, publisher trust, and review status; code review cannot safely choose that permanent public boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrowed evidence contract
options.body: Proceed only after immutable release evidence is separated from current package configuration, the response is fully typed, compatibility is documented, and live HTTP proof is supplied.

options.title: Defer to the trust RFC
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 resolves the public review tiers and package-versus-publisher trust model.

options.title: Keep existing evidence surfaces
options.body: Decline the additional endpoint and instead document how clients compose the existing detail, release, security, and readiness APIs.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrowed evidence contract
recommendation.body: Proceed only after immutable release evidence is separated from current package configuration, the response is fully typed, compatibility is documented, and live HTTP proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the collaborator already engaged on reviewing this exact API proposal and are connected to adjacent plugin API work.
